sn35.6:1.1: Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || Saddā || Gandhā || Rasā || Phoṭṭhabbā || Dhammā anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātāti
